patches.what: Redirect the only Global-Local Topic allennlp import to the vendored compatibility module.
patches.why: EasyECR pins torch==2.0.1, while the final allennlp release providing SelfAttentiveSpanExtractor requires torch<1.13. The dependency solver proves those constraints cannot coexist.
not_changed: Global-Local Topic architecture, loss, optimiser and hyperparameters
MAVEN-ERE loader, selection rule, clustering threshold grid and prediction path

patches.what: Port only AllenNLP v2.10.1 SelfAttentiveSpanExtractor's default no-width-embedding path.
patches.why: This is the one upstream API Global-Local Topic needs; retaining its learned global attention and inclusive-span masking is more faithful than changing the EasyECR runtime stack.

patches.what: Permit the existing prediction path to consume an unlabeled MAVEN-ERE test shape by using a mention-local placeholder only where the upstream batch object requires a cluster id, then return no gold-derived Event container after distance prediction.
patches.why: The upstream MAVEN adapter omits event_id on test mentions, but adapt_maven_data and predict read it even though Global-Local Topic's prediction logits and clustering need only mentions, types and pair distances. Supplying labelled evaluation records would leak gold clusters. The placeholder is never used as a prediction feature or exported cluster; it only keeps the existing all-pair batch shape valid.
not_changed: Longformer/BERT inputs, pair-distance logits, connected-component clustering and threshold selection
labelled train and selection-dev behavior, where event_id remains the original value

patches.what: Replace the upstream post-construction hard-coded seed 42 with the explicit configured seed before model construction.
patches.why: A seed set after the module is built cannot control its initial weights. The frozen G-19 run requires seed 13, so the configuration must set it before both module construction and data-loader creation.
not_changed: Global-Local Topic architecture, loss, optimiser, learning-rate schedule and clustering threshold grid
the one fixed seed value (13), which remains declared by the project run manifest rather than selected from results

why_vendored: gpu-4090 reaches project code through git, not a server-side clone. Vendoring the official source at its fixed commit makes the required compatibility patch reviewable and keeps remote artifacts traceable.
